snippet.description:
An ancient egyptian figure pointing toward a mysterious object carved in stone

Deep within an ancient Egyptian scene, a carved figure appears to gesture toward an unusual object placed beside it. The object’s distinctive shape and detailed surface make this small section of the carving especially fascinating.

Its original meaning is not immediately clear, leaving us to examine the artwork and consider what the ancient craftsmen may have intended to show.
.
.
.
